summary.policy: every file inside the 18x4-closure programme directories is hashed individually unless its extension is byte-code/scratch (.pyc/.tmp), it exceeds 64 MiB, or it is reached through a reparse point (directory junctions leave the repository and are recorded as pruned rather than followed); everything else is aggregated per top-level work/ directory with a stable sorted-path/size/mtime digest.  No file is declared absent merely because it is git-ignored, and no hashed file is declared scientifically valid merely because it exists.
